description: NotifyHub notifications + agent status: turn completion, errors, permission prompts, questions, live session state

hooks.command: sh -c 'h="${NOTIFYHUB_CLI_HOST-127.0.0.1}"; p="${NOTIFYHUB_CLI_PORT-9080}"; s="${NOTIFYHUB_CLI_SCHEME-http}"; m="${HOST_MODEL-}"; m="${m#"${m%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; m="${m%"${m##*[![:space:]]}"}"; case "$m" in ""|Unknown) m="${HOSTNAME-}"; m="${m#"${m%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; m="${m%"${m##*[![:space:]]}"}"; m="${m:-$(hostname)}";; esac; [ -n "$h" ] && [ -n "$p" ] && curl -fsS -m 2 -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" -H "x-notifyhub-host: $m" --data-binary @- "$s://$h:$p/api/status/claude/running" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0'
